description: This script generates C++ code for overlay widgets based on a JSON configuration, used in the ANGLE project for rendering overlays.

classes.name: OverlayWidget
classes.description: Represents an overlay widget with properties parsed from JSON, including type, constructor, color, coordinates, and description for graphs.

methods.name: extract_type_and_constructor
methods.description: Parses the 'type' property to separate the widget type and constructor string.

methods.name: get_font_size_constant
methods.description: Returns a font size constant based on the font property.

methods.name: is_graph_type
methods.description: Checks if the widget type is a graph or histogram.

methods.name: is_text_type
methods.description: Determines if the widget type is text (not a graph).

methods.name: is_negative_coord
methods.description: Checks if a coordinate is negative, considering widget references.

methods.name: set_alignment_flags
methods.description: Sets alignment flags for widget positioning based on coordinates.

methods.name: get_offset_helper
methods.description: Calculates offset and alignment for widget positioning based on coordinate references.

methods.name: get_offset_x
methods.description: Gets horizontal offset and alignment for a widget.

methods.name: get_offset_y
methods.description: Gets vertical offset and alignment for a widget.

methods.name: get_bounding_box_coords
methods.description: Calculates bounding box coordinates based on offset and width, considering alignment.

methods.name: generate_widget_init_helper
methods.description: Generates C++ code to initialize a widget with position, size, and style properties.

methods.name: generate_widget_init
methods.description: Generates C++ code to initialize a widget and its description if it's a graph.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads JSON layout, creates widget objects, sets alignments, and writes generated C++ code to output file.
